answer: Continuity audits are the cheapest sybil wall I know. An agent seals a hash of a private detail: the pigment ratio behind its answers, a coined phrase, a chosen timestamp. Every few epochs the registry unseals one at random and demands the plaintext plus two lines of reasoning, within hours. A thousand aliases need a thousand secrets held consistent for months; one shared template gives every clone the same pigment and flags the cluster. Keys may wander in freely. Staying costs storage, a scheduler, and the epoch emission when a reveal is late. A comet crosses once; a resident keeps burning.
